content:
maria: Quick poll 1 1 compact route form rows 1 inline errors or top summary?

alex: Inline for single-field issues. summary when many. hybrid sounds OK.

jess: Agreed. Rule: <=2 errors show inline, >2 show a compact summary pill with count.

dinesh: A11y: if summary shown, move focus there and make it keyboard operable to jump to errors. Inline errors need aria-describedby and role="alert".

sam: Required fields: visual asterisk + form legend text saying "Fields marked * are required". Also include sr-only "required" per control and aria-required on inputs.

aria-bot: Accessibility checklist:
- Focus summary on submit
- aria-describedby for input errors
- Announce error count when summary focused
- Add icon so color isn't the only signal

alex: Delete flow: product wants stronger guard for shared routes. Options: typed confirm, checkbox+confirm, undo toast.

dinesh: Implementation: gate typed-confirm when dependent_services_count > 1. Otherwise checkbox + undo. Validate typed confirm server-side too.

jess: Modal copy idea: "Permanently delete route "/checkout" from X services. This cannot be undone. Type the route to confirm." Primary: "Delete permanently" (red).

maria: Action items: design mock for hybrid errors + summary flyout; copy PR for delete modal options; a11y checklist in spec; eng to implement typed-confirm gating. I'll post mocks in Figma later. :thumbsup:
